exposure: Isthmocele size (measured by imaging and macroscopically)
outcome: Accuracy of isthmocele diagnosis by imaging
Correlation of isthmocele dimensions with clinical symptoms
cohort: 60 women with at least one prior C-section undergoing hysterectomy
finding: Imaging provided largely accurate measurements of isthmocele dimensions, and while a higher number of prior C-sections was associated with greater isthmocele severity, it did not affect the incidence or remaining myometrial thickness.
mod_finding: The study found that the number of prior C-sections was correlated with isthmocele severity.
